title: 2968. Apply Operations to Maximize Frequency Score

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations on the array: - Choose i = 0, and increase the value of nums[0] by 1. The resulting array is [2,2,6,4]. - Choose i = 3, and decrease the value of nums[3] by 1. The resulting array is [2,2,6,3]. - Choose i = 3, and decrease the value of nums[3] by 1. The resulting array is [2,2,6,2]. The element 2 is the most frequent in the final array so our score is 3. It can be shown that we cannot achieve a better score.
We cannot apply any operations so our score will be the frequency of the most frequent element in the original array, which is 3.
